svg.aria-label: Two kinds of sticker in the composer's emoji picker. Packs are added from a link pasted into Manage, previewed first: an naddr, a 30031:author hex:identifier coordinate, or a sonarprivacy.xyz/stickers?a= link. MDK installs the pack and publishes your kind-10031 list, so your other devices pick it up; packs are not offered in threads, which are kind 1111. Your own stickers are imported from a static PNG, WebP or JPEG of up to 4 MiB and 4096 pixels per side and listed in stickers/library.bin. They are sent as an image tagged wn-sticker, other clients see an ordinary image, and they stay on this device without syncing. In the picker, click a tile to send it and right-click it to manage it.

g.text: Paste one into Manage to preview it first:
